purpose: Public input for a document-led installation; no installer is included.

lark_cli.scope_union_rule: For each enabled profile, sort and de-duplicate its exact scopes, then join with commas for auth login --scope.
lark_cli.profile_rule: Use a named profile selected with --profile; do not switch or overwrite the global profile.

card_callback_carrier.transport: one shared SDK WSClient owned by the framework gateway
card_callback_carrier.event_or_callback: card.action.trigger is a callback and requires a valid handler response within the provider ACK window.

user_oauth.admin_approval: The tenant administrator must approve any restricted user scope shown by the consent page; user consent is still required.
user_oauth.resource_share: The consenting user must be a member of every destination chat and have the required reader/editor/admin access to each Base, table, Wiki space/node, Drive document or folder used.

app.admin_approval: Publish the app version after changing app permissions. A tenant administrator must approve restricted app permissions before the bot token can use them.
app.resource_share: Add the bot to each destination chat. Share each Base/table, Wiki space/node, Drive file/folder and comment target with the bot at the least role needed; app scopes do not grant resource membership.

wiki.enabled_when: The recipient enables Wiki listing or node creation.
wiki.admin_approval: Publish/admin-approve the app scopes if the tenant requires it.
wiki.resource_share: Share the target Wiki space and parent node with the acting identity.

drive_read.enabled_when: The recipient enables Drive listing, Markdown fetch, or file download.
drive_read.admin_approval: Approve/publish the app permissions as required by the tenant.
drive_read.resource_share: Share the folder/file with the acting identity. Do not request every API alternative: use only the scope required by the selected CLI shortcut.

comments.enabled_when: The recipient enables comment read, create, or reply on a specific document-like resource.
comments.admin_approval: Comment write permissions may require tenant-admin approval and app-version publication.
comments.resource_share: The acting identity must have comment permission on the exact document, sheet, slide, Base or Wiki target. A comment scope does not authorize access to unrelated resources.
comments.event_note: No comment event subscription is part of this default contract. Do not add an event scope or a second CLI consumer unless a separately enabled SDK module supplies an exact event contract.

events.console_action: Enable card callback configuration and publish the app version.
Enable the message receive event only when the recipient enables that consumer.

card_callback.admin_approval: The app administrator must enable the callback/event subscriptions in the developer console and publish the version.
card_callback.resource_share: The bot must be a member of the chat containing the card and must be allowed to send and update its own card message.
card_callback.transport_rule: Use the existing shared Node SDK WSClient as the only long connection. Do not run lark-cli event consume beside it.

operations.resource_access: The user owns the newly created Base or has explicit destination access.
The bot has destination access; the returned permission grant must be read back before claiming user access.
Acting identity can edit the Base.
Acting identity can edit/read the target table schema.
Acting identity can read the Base.
Acting identity can read the target table.
Acting identity can create records in the target table.
Acting identity can update records in the target table.
Acting identity can create/update; update-vs-create is selected by record_id, not a business key.

base_contract.writeback_rule: Create or adopt resources only after explicit ownership/access is recorded. Save returned IDs and read back the semantic table/field/record state; exit 0 or an accepted request is not proof.
